With the MLB Playoffs over and done with , the top two teams from each league face off against each other in the 2026 World Series to compete to win the Commissioner’s Trophy. It’s no surprise that teams with the best record in the American League, Rays at (98-64), and National League, Brewers at (103-59), made it to the championship series this year.
The championship series begins, as the Tampa Bay Rays take on the Milwaukee Brewers at American Family Field in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Game 1 starts at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on Friday, Oct. 23 on FOX . With the start of the World Series, it’s likely matches may features a few of celebrities in attendance to support their favorite teams, like Rays-fans John Cena, Dick Vitale, Titus O’Neil and others; and Brewers-fan Tom Brady, Eric Benét, Stephen Colbert, Allison Mahal and others.
And although last year’s World Series drew in an average of more than 15 million viewers , it’s unlikely this year’s championship series would bring in the same (or better) viewership numbers. Last year, one of the biggest sports markets in sports was represented with the Los Angeles Dodgers, which also featured the biggest superstar in baseball Shohei Ohtani. For this year, both markets are smaller in Tampa and Milwaukee, and neither team has a superstar caliber play on their rosters.
